label: Lossless additive readout of maintained feeds in a relay prefix
definition: The count of a prefix of length k starts at zero and adds one unit per maintained feed at positions from zero to k minus one. A position without a maintained feed adds zero.
note: A measurement law for a richer test on the same roster. Reporting one unit per feed requires additive contributions with no loss or ambiguity; the Boolean local activity rule alone supplies no such count.
